purpose: Independent reproducibility. The canonical transaction proves the mechanism works. This proves it works for someone who is not us.

preconditions.keeperhubAccount: created the same morning, unrelated to the development account
preconditions.repository: fresh git clone of the published repo, commit de7ceab
preconditions.environmentVariable: KEEPERHUB_API_KEY explicitly unset in the child process
preconditions.credentialEntry: typed into the hidden interactive prompt over a real pty, as a human would

whatThisEstablishes: The published artifact works from a fresh clone on an account with no relationship to ours.
The credential boundary holds end to end: the key was typed into the hidden prompt over a real pty and never echoed, verified programmatically (keyEchoedToTerminal: false).
Gas sponsorship applies to a brand-new organisation, not just to ours. The wallet held zero ETH before and after.
The sender assertion holds on a second, independent organisation wallet. It was previously measured on one.

faucet.why: KeeperHub sponsored the execution, so the gas policy correctly refused to fund. A zero balance is not a reason to fund anything, and this run is a second independent demonstration of that.

nonceObservation.note: The organisation wallet is an EIP-7702 delegated account. The first sponsored execution installs the delegation, which consumes exactly one nonce. The development wallet has made 8 canary executions and its nonce is also 1, so the nonce moves once and never again.
